jobs.title: Night Security Officer — Hotel Guest Safety
jobs.description:
Hyatt in Chicago, IL is seeking an Overnight Security Officer to ensure safety for guests and staff across the hotel. You will monitor premises, respond to incidents, and maintain secure operations during the night shift. The role requires reliability and teamwork in a fast-paced hospitality setting.

Ideal candidates will be able to work overnights, weekends, and holidays, with flexibility as needed. Training and benefits are provided as part of Hyatt's commitment to security and guest safety.

jobs.title: Hotel Security Patrol: Customer-Focused Growth & Training
jobs.description:
Allied Universal is hiring a Security Officer Patrol Compliance in Chicago, IL. You will monitor and patrol hotel locations, deter incidents, and assist guests and staff with security-related needs while upholding responsive, professional service.

The role emphasizes customer service, communication, and teamwork within a caring culture that values agility, reliability, innovation, and integrity. Full-time position with a competitive hourly pay rate of $19.50.

jobs.title: Hotel Security Officer - Patrol, Respond, Protect
jobs.description: The Whitehall Hotel in Chicago is seeking a Hotel Security Officer responsible for patrolling the hotel premises to maintain order and enforce regulations. The candidate will be tasked with investigating disturbances, complaints, and ensuring safety compliance. Qualifications include a one-year certificate from a technical school or related experience, strong communication skills, and the ability to work flexible hours, including weekends. Being at least 21 years of age is required.

jobs.title: Guest-Focused Security Officer - Hotel
jobs.description: The Facilities Group is seeking motivated individuals for the Security Officer position in Chicago, Illinois. This full-time role involves ensuring guest safety, conducting security checks, and requiring a PERC Card. Strong performance is rewarded with advancement opportunities. Ideal candidates will have a professional demeanor and prior customer service experience. Flexible availability is a must. Join us at The Facilities Group to build a rewarding career in security.

jobs.title: On-Call Luxury Hotel Security Officer
jobs.description:
Four Seasons Hotel Chicago is seeking an On Call Security Officer to join our Security Team and maintain a safe environment for guests, colleagues and property. The role involves standing for long periods, performing bag checks, and patrolling multiple areas of the hotel with discretion and professionalism.

Candidates should have prior security experience in luxury hotel settings and demonstrate excellent presentation and interpersonal abilities.

jobs.title: Overnight Security & Loss Prevention - Luxury Downtown Hotel
jobs.description:
RadNet, Inc. is seeking an Overnight Security Loss Prevention Officer to ensure the safety and wellbeing of guests and team members at our luxurious downtown Chicago hotel. This role requires a wealth of relevant security experience and strong interpersonal skills to manage complex situations and foster a harmonious atmosphere.

You will be recognized for your dedication through a variety of benefits, including comprehensive healthcare, a 401(K) plan, and employee perks. Join us to thrive as part of an inclusive and supportive team culture.

jobs.title: Hotel Security Officer | Guest Safety & Incident Response
jobs.description:
Hyatt Hotels Corporation is seeking a Security Officer at the Grand Hyatt Deer Valley Hotel in Chicago, Illinois. The role involves overseeing the safety and security of guests and employees, strictly adhering to safety standards, and completing incident reports as necessary.

The position offers a schedule of four 10-hour shifts each week, promoting a balanced work-life routine. Candidates should have good communication skills and be able to work flexible hours.

Benefits include medical insurance, 401K matching, and paid time off.
